source: decision.md section 6, Bridge API: Shell contract v1

types.image: {mediaType, data}: a photo, base64 without the data: prefix
types.?: after a type: optional, left out when unset

intents.name: ping
intents.does: Is the page there, and on which contract (the -fpSmoke launch logs: fp: ping ok v1)

intents.name: shell.covered
intents.does: A native screen covers the page: skip programmatic focus while on. The shell sends on:false once its screen is gone, after every dismissal (the owner's and the page's); the page also uncovers itself once it has taken its last native screen down (its own dismiss, a refused present, a model it could not build, screens.off)

intents.name: coach.snapshot
intents.does: The coach model now, as _nativeJSON(model)

intents.name: coach.send
intents.does: Send the owner's message through coachSend; idempotent by nonce (the page remembers 20); usePending sends the page's pending photo

intents.name: coach.chip
intents.does: Send an empty-chat suggestion's words

intents.name: coach.action
intents.does: A reply's action chip: send text if message id is still the newest reply and nothing is in flight

intents.name: coach.stop
intents.does: coachStop; {ok: false, error: 'idle'} with nothing in flight, 'just-sent' in a turn's first half second (as the web Stop: the second tap of a double tap on Send)

intents.name: coach.retry
intents.does: coachRetryLast, only where the chat offers Try again (the trailing message's chip is retry): else {ok: false, error: 'stale'}; 'busy' while a reply is in flight

intents.name: coach.keep
intents.does: PLAN CHANGES Keep changes or Got it on message id (_ledgerKeep by id) while the page's card is up: else {ok: false, error: 'stale'}; 'gone' when no message has the id

intents.name: coach.undo
intents.does: PLAN CHANGES Undo on message id (_ledgerUndo by id; its confirm is forwarded) only while the page's card offers Undo (its undo point is current): else {ok: false, error: 'stale'} and nothing is asked; 'gone' when no message has the id

intents.name: coach.model
intents.does: setCoachModel(model): the header switch sends its next

intents.name: coach.back
intents.does: Back to the Coach home

intents.name: coach.cancelIntake
intents.does: _confirmCancelIntake (its confirm is forwarded)

intents.name: coach.restorePrevious
intents.does: restoreRoutineBackup (its confirm is forwarded)

intents.name: coach.regenerate
intents.does: resetCustomRoutine: the empty chat's Reset programme (its confirm is forwarded)

intents.name: coach.openSettings
intents.does: switchTab('settings'): the key error's Open Settings

intents.name: coach.image
intents.does: The page's pending photo with this key (a shared image); stale key: {ok: false, error: 'gone'}

intents.name: coach.clearImage
intents.does: clearPendingImage

intents.name: coach.draftTaken
intents.does: The native composer took the page's draft with this nonce

intents.name: confirm
intents.does: The answer to a forwarded confirm; after a reload: {ok: false, error: 'stale'}

intents.name: toast.undo
intents.does: Undo on a forwarded toast

intents.name: screens.off
intents.does: A native piece is off for the rest of the document: the page shows its own again. why: no-hello or failures (the native breaker, kept for the page build), withdrawn (the policy file or the device switch, until the next document), needs (a piece this one needs went off); for screen tabs the fallback's word (page, refused, no-hello, failures, policy, switch). draft (screen coach only): the native composer's unsent words; the page stores them durably (its composer and kt_coach_handover) and only then answers took: true

intents.name: tabs.select
intents.does: Tabs mode: the shell selected tab (the owner's tap, a deep link, a stray redirected) as funnel run seq; the page runs its local switch when seq is newer than any it has seen and never calls selectTab back; again: the owner's re-tap of the selected tab. off when the page is not in tabs mode

intents.name: tabs.bar
intents.does: Tabs mode: a bar geometry change the shell made on its own (whole points); applied only when rev is newer. off when the page is not in tabs mode

intents.name: coachHome.snapshot
intents.does: The CoachHomeModel now, as _nativeJSON(model); off when the native Coach tab is not in use in this document

intents.name: coachHome.openChat
intents.does: openCoachChat: the chat's present follows and the shell pushes it; off, nokey

intents.name: coachHome.setKey
intents.does: The connect screen's key (saveApiKey's rule without the DOM, answered before any network); the only carrier of the key, never printed or recorded; off, stale (a key is already saved), invalid (checked in that order)

intents.name: coachHome.disconnect
intents.does: clearApiKey (its confirm is forwarded); off, nokey, stale

intents.name: coachHome.clearChat
intents.does: _confirmClearChat (its confirm is forwarded); off, empty, stale

intents.name: coachHome.startIntake
intents.does: startRoutineIntake (asks first over an existing chat); off, nokey, has-programme, intake, stale

intents.name: coachHome.openStarter
intents.does: Select Log through the page's own switchTab, then openStarterIntake; off, has-programme

answers.refused: {ok: false, error}: the page's own reason (stale, busy, idle, just-sent, gone, ...): not a bridge failure
answers.failed: {ok: false, error: 'unknown-intent' | 'bad-args' | 'exception'}, a timeout, a script error or an answer without ok: counted by the 3-failure breaker

messages.name: hello
messages.answers: {v, screens, up?, tabs?} (v 0 and why when refused; up: screens the shell still shows from the document before, which the page takes over or dismisses; tabs {selected, seq, bar: {h, safe, rev}} iff tabs is negotiated)
messages.does: The page speaks contract v and can hand these screens to Swift

messages.name: bootDone
messages.does: The end of boot whatever painted: disarms the store breaker; the OTA confirm moves here

messages.name: dismiss
messages.does: The page left the screen (another tab, the runner, the end of intake)

messages.name: toast
messages.does: showToast or showUndoToast while a native screen covers the page; style ok, pr or err

messages.name: confirm
messages.does: _ktConfirm while a native screen covers the page; tone danger, accent or neutral

messages.name: log
messages.does: A line for the shell's log

messages.name: status
messages.answers: {v, shell, page, screens: {<screen>: {on, live, off, trip, why, at, canReset}}, verdicts, counters: {since, leftWindow, hidden, trips, markers}}
messages.does: Settings > About: every native screen this binary has, whether the next document may show it and why not (off: device, policy, crash, breaker; trip: no-hello or failures), and the shell's counters (this launch and in all); refresh: true (About's Check the switches now) runs a forced policy fetch first, at most once a minute

messages.name: reset
messages.does: Settings > About's Try the native chat again: the screen's crash verdicts and native breaker record go, so the next document may show it (this one keeps what it negotiated)

messages.name: visibility
messages.does: The page went hidden or visible (document.visibilityState, at its Date.now()) while a native screen covered it; the shell counts a hidden page while the app is in use, never by design

messages.name: selectTab
messages.answers: {tab, seq}: the shell's selection after the funnel and the counter
messages.does: Tabs mode: the page's switchTab asks the shell to select tab before its local switch; intent (chat, intake) is what the page is about to show there. Rejected off (no live tab root) or bad-tab

messages.name: sheets
messages.does: Tabs mode: whether an overlay that covers the page's own bar is open in this document (sent at the end of boot, then on every net change); the bar hides on a web tab while open. Rejected off (no live tab root)

messages.name: setSwitch
messages.does: The shell's own device switch for a piece the root decides (only tabs): off acts at once and at every launch after, on from the next launch. Rejected no-switch for any other screen
